sentences.text:
It is respectfully submitted as follows:-
1.

The Respondent No.2 has filed a complaint against the petitioners and others for the alleged offences punishable under Section 498(A), 506 of Indian Penal Code and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, arraying the Petitioners as Accused No 1 to 3.
2.
The crux of the complaint stands thus, that she is the Wife of the Petitioner NO.1
the marriage took place on 15.12.2021 at Samskruthi Swasthik Convention Hall.
After the marriage they were residing with the in laws, where the Accused started harassing her mentally.
The Accused persons demanded dowry etc.

The Respondent police based on the Complaint of the Respondent No 2 registered an FIR for the offence punishable under Section 498(A), 506 of Indian Penal Code and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, and implicated the Petitioners as Accused No 1 to 3 respectively after the investigation the Respondent police has filed charge sheet against the Petitioners in CC.No. 4553/2023.
The Respondent No.1 Police dropped the charges in so far as S.3 & 4 of Dowry NC: 2023:KHC:24961 Prohibition Act while filing the chargesheet.

That the accused/Petitioner in the above case and the complainant have compromised and settled the above matter out of the court due to the intervention of the Well-Wishers and friends of both the parties and thus the complainant/respondent No.2 do not wish to continue with the above case as against the petitioners in the above criminal petition.
and complainant/Respondent No. 2 have compromised and settled the above Criminal Case by entering into a Mutual Divorce in M.C. No 3019/2023 before the Family Court Bengaluru.
Further both the parties shall have no right to institute any proceedings/case before the court of law as against each other.

Hence it is humbly prayed that, this Hon'ble court may be pleased to permit the above named petitioners and the respondent NO.2/Complainant to compound and compromise the above case in the interest or justice.
4.
In the light of the offence being one punishable under Section 498A of IPC, I deem it appropriate to accept the NC: 2023:KHC:24961 compromise and close the proceedings qua the petitioners.

Hence, the following:
ORDER i) Criminal Petition is disposed.
ii) The proceedings in CC No.4553/2023 (Crime No.184/2012 of Basavanagudi Police, Station, Bangalore) stands quashed.
